item.tib: dbal mo gnon pa'i las thigs gyi gran gyi bshed ma
item.coloph: dbal mo srog 'khor las kyi byang bu/ zhang zhung mkhas pa stong rgyung brnags (brnag) pa/ dam nyams la zag can/ slob dpon gsang na rang che 'byin/ lags (lag) tu byung na zongs du 'tshongs('tshong /)bon gyi dam sri bka' rkun rigs la gsang*/ rgyal blon ru tra ge shan gshed mar shog bstan pa'i sgron me byed par shog phyi rab (rabs) sprul pa'i bstan pa spel/ ces gsungs ste (te/)lcags 'phrang la gtad cing sbas pa'o//
